content:
Overview

Abbottabad is a city in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa with a population of 350,000. A hill station in the Hazara region known for its pleasant climate, educational institutions, and scenic beauty. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9a growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
